stale_manifest_quote_evidence.quote_text: Do you know that one of the great problems of our age is that we are governed by people who care more about feelings than they do about thoughts and ideas.
stale_manifest_quote_evidence.speaker: Abi Morgan (spoken by Meryl Streep as Margaret Thatcher)

stale_manifest_quote_evidence.quote_text: The negative aspects of equality are that lazy people, passive individuals, and irresponsible employees profit at the expense of dedicated and diligent employees, and unskilled workers profit at the expense of skilled ones.
stale_manifest_quote_evidence.speaker: Alexander Dubček (quoted by Margaret Thatcher)

stale_manifest_quote_evidence.quote_text: It used to be about trying to do something. Now it's about trying to be someone.
stale_manifest_quote_evidence.speaker: Abi Morgan (spoken by Meryl Streep as Margaret Thatcher)
